caption: The drawing depicts a technical architectural design of a symmetrical structure resembling a decorative gate or entryway, shown in both frontal and side views. The structure is composed of two prominent vertical columns on either side, each topped with a spherical finial. The top section of the structure contains a rectangular horizontal band featuring geometric ornamentation, with two square diamond shapes and two rectangular panels, one on each side of the center. Below this band, there are two central rectangular doors, each with a series of concentric rectangular and trapezoidal frames creating a decorative, layered effect. Flanking the doors are narrower vertical rectangular panels that also have outlined decorative details. The bottom of the structure has a series of stepped rectangular platforms, forming a base for the overall design. The lines in the drawing are black on a beige or yellowed background, and there are measurement notations indicated along the edges. There is no shading or color beyond the monochrome lines and background.
